newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - TRADE DEFICIT ESTIMATED TO GROW FURTHER.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - TRADE DEFICIT ESTIMATED TO GROW FURTHER.

text.p: Estonia's trade deficit is estimated to grow to 17.5 - 19 billion kroons in 1997 compared to a deficit of 13.5 billion kroons the year before, the ministry of economy said on Tuesday.
"The deficit in 1998 might increase even further," Jaanus Salum, the head of the foreign trade department, told a news conference.
Salum said that exports will certainly start to grow faster than imports. He added that the ministry estimates the growth from the second half of 1998.

During the first quarter in 1997, exports grew by 8.3 percent while import increased by 3.3 percent. The trade deficit was 3.9 billion kroons compared to 2.5 billion kroons in the same period in 1996.
